info.name: THAI Please — For AI (Explore shop search)
info.description: CURRENT STATUS (2026-10-28): POST /recommendations/search is commented out and returns404. Requests04/07 only check this disabled status; no search IDs are captured, so the semantic search-to-hydration flow is unavailable. Discovery, descriptions and batch hydration remain available with manually supplied in-scope IDs. Focused collection verified against commit 421c916beb70cb1f575d6ddbfbea3088c128713c. Nest API only; no payments, Coins, seller/government writes, OSRM or direct provider endpoints. Set baseUrl and CUSTOMER credentials, run01→02→03→04→05→06. GET discovery is paginated; categoryIds is CSV and empty means all. Scope must stay identical across search/descriptions/hydration. Never export saved tokens/passwords. Runtime/provider/DB availability has not been verified by creating this collection.

request.description: Setup only: enter your existing CUSTOMER credentials. No registration or business writes.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Access token', () => pm.expect(r.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty); if (r.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('customerToken', r.accessToken); }

request.description: Use returned IDs in categoryIds (comma-separated). Empty categoryIds means all categories.

Empty-search discovery. Saves at most 20 IDs from this page for description inspection. This is ONE page, not all shops: while hasNextPage=true set page=nextPage and rerun. LLM orchestration independently rebuilds the complete scope on the server.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Stores and pagination', () => { pm.expect(r.stores).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(r.meta.hasNextPage).to.be.a('boolean'); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('hasNextPage', String(r.meta.hasNextPage)); pm.collectionVariables.set('nextPage', String(Number(r.meta.page) + 1)); pm.collectionVariables.set('descriptionShopIds', JSON.stringify(r.stores.slice(0, 20).map(s => s.id))); }

request.description: Temporarily unavailable at user request (2026-10-28). POST route decorator is commented out; expected HTTP 404. Method/service retained for future activation. No recommendation IDs are saved; search/hydration chaining is unavailable.

exec: pm.test('Reserved search route is unavailable (404)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

request.description: Scoped CUSTOMER HTTP API for inspection/external integration; max100 unique decimal IDs. The actual LLM tool is internal, max20 IDs and request-bound scope; this request does not itself run the LLM. descriptionShopIds is populated by nearby discovery.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Description data', () => { pm.expect(r.shops).to.be.an('array'); r.shops.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(s.description === null || typeof s.description === 'string').to.eql(true); }); }); }

item.name: 06 Hydrate recommended IDs for existing UI

request.description: Max100 IDs per call. Returns existing Explore store DTO in requested order; stores that left APPROVED/radius/category scope are omitted. Keep scope identical to search. An empty result is valid.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const r = pm.response.json(); const ids = JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('hydrateShopIds')); pm.test('Hydrated stores preserve requested order and scope', () => { pm.expect(r.stores).to.be.an('array'); let previous = -1; r.stores.forEach(s => { const index = ids.indexOf(s.id); pm.expect(index).to.be.above(previous); previous = index; pm.expect(s.distanceKm).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(s.categories).to.be.an('array'); }); }); }
